response.sql:
WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.WBC) as avg_wbc,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL THEN l.HGB / l.HCT ELSE NULL END) as hgb_hct_ratio
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
ratio_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) as overall_mean
  FROM patient_stats
  WHERE hgb_hct_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ps.ID,
  ps.SEX,
  ps.avg_wbc,
  ps.hgb_hct_ratio,
  ps.hgb_hct_ratio - rs.overall_mean as ratio_diff
FROM patient_stats ps
CROSS JOIN ratio_stats rs
WHERE rs.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.hgb_hct_ratio > rs.overall_mean
ORDER BY ps.hgb_hct_ratio - rs.overall_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The patient HGB/HCT ratio is the average of individual per-record ratios (calculated only for records where both HGB and HCT are non-NULL), rather than (average HGB) / (average HCT)

alternatives.interpretation: The HGB/HCT ratio should be (average HGB) / (average HCT) instead of the average of individual ratios
